fund_team_is_plain.name: fund_team_is_plain
fund_team_is_plain.value: "fund"."kind" <> 'team' or ("fund"."type" = 'fund' and "fund"."vat_rate" is null and "fund"."group_name" is null)

stock_movement_prices.name: stock_movement_prices
stock_movement_prices.value:
("stock_movement"."kind" = 'receipt' and "stock_movement"."unit_net" is not null and "stock_movement"."unit_gross" is not null and "stock_movement"."unit_team" is not null)
        or ("stock_movement"."kind" <> 'receipt' and "stock_movement"."unit_net" is null and "stock_movement"."unit_gross" is null and "stock_movement"."unit_team" is null)
